data.subject: Your 13F and a recent HWBK filing
data.body:
Hi,

Ategra's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in HWBK and PKBK.

On September 4, 2026, HWBK reported an acquisition or disposition of assets in an 8-K Item 2.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/893847/000089384726000091/hwbk-20260903.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
